fashion.Overview: Cult Party Kei is primarily a second-hand/thrifted fashion. It’s best to use 2-3 colors in an outfit. Most outfits are white or cream for the most part, but adding touches of bright red or pastels (e.g. pastel pink, lilac) is common. For example, pastel nightgowns are a staple piece. However, a high proportion of pastels in an outfit can make it look Yume Kawaii, so be sure to focus on whites or pastels on the less vibrant side. Quilts used for jackets and skirts and yo-yo accessories are usually very colorful though. The silhouette is usually slightly baggy/loose fitting, but with a loosely defined high waist (around your natural waist line or higher) but not with a tightly belted waist.…
